calls.statement: SELECT channel_code, channel_id, staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(net_amount) net, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.quantity, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'),
ret AS (
  SELECT r.sales_line_id, count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) n_ids, sum(r.quantity_returned) q, sum(r.refund_net) refund, min(r.return_date) mn, max(r.return_date) mx
  FROM fact_return_line r GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.format, s.channel_code, s.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) lines, sum(s.quantity) units, sum(s.net_amount) net_sold,
 count(r.sales_line_id) lines_returned, sum(r.n_rows) ret_rows, sum(r.n_ids) ret_ids, sum(r.q) units_ret, sum(r.refund) refund_net, min(r.mn), max(r.mx)
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) lines, min(return_date), max(return_date),
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_amt,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' OR f.sales_line_id IS NULL

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount, f.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag),
ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) q FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format,
  round(100 * coalesce(sum(r.refund_net),0) / sum(s.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
  round(100 * coalesce(sum(r.q),0) / sum(s.quantity), 2) AS unit_rate_pct
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (sales_line_id) GROUP BY s.format ORDER BY s.format
